blocks.content:
The Chairperson and members are appointed by the President of India on the recommendation of a committee consisting of:
• Prime Minister (Chairperson)
• Speaker of Lok Sabha
• Home Minister
• Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha
• Leader of Opposition in Rajya Sabha
• Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha
The Chairperson and members are appointed by the President of India on the recommendation of a committee

items: Crucial distinction: The committee includes the Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha, NOT the Chairman of Rajya Sabha (Vice President).
Notice that Leaders of Opposition from BOTH Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha are members of this selection committee.
The Home Minister is the only Cabinet Minister specifically listed besides the Prime Minister.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Chairperson and members are officially appointed by the President of India.
Appointments are made strictly on the recommendation of a dedicated selection committee.
The selection committee is headed by the Prime Minister as its Chairperson.
Committee members include parliamentary leaders from both the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha, along with the Home Minister.
